comment: Converted from meatpiHQ/wican-fw vehicle_profiles/vw/e-golf.json by tools/convert_wican.py. WiCAN init: ATSP6;ATST96;ATSH7E5;. Expression re-basing: WiCAN exprs are 0-based over ELM327 response data including PCI bytes; converted to this schema's isotp semantics (single-frame: raw frame, PCI at B1; multi-frame: assembled payload = FF bytes 2..7 + CF bytes 1..7). Frame layout per pid from the WiCAN pid string's trailing frame-count digit, inferred from byte refs when absent.
